description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing connectors in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment, including loading, saving, and configuring connector sources, retrieving language strings, and manipulating metadata for the connector interface.

classes.name: ConnectorUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage connector sources, including retrieval, caching, configuration, language support, and metadata management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getConnector
methods.description: Retrieve connector data by ID, optionally refreshing the cache.

methods.name: eapmEnabled
methods.description: Check if external account profiles are enabled for a specific connector.

methods.name: getSearchDefs
methods.description: Retrieve search definitions for connector modules, creating and caching defaults if necessary.

methods.name: getViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieve merged view definitions for connector modules, filtered by specific sources if provided.

methods.name: getMergeViewDefs
methods.description: Deprecated; retrieves merged view definitions for connectors, similar to getViewDefs, with file caching.

methods.name: getConnectors
methods.description: Retrieve all available connector configurations, utilizing caching and refresh logic.

methods.name: saveConnectors
methods.description: Persist connector configuration data to file.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Scan a directory to find and instantiate source configurations for connectors.

methods.name: getDisplayConfig
methods.description: Retrieve or generate the display configuration for connector sources per module.

methods.name: getModuleConnectors
methods.description: Get all connector details associated with a specific module.

methods.name: isModuleEnabled
methods.description: Check whether a particular module is enabled to use connectors.

methods.name: isSourceEnabled
methods.description: Check whether a specific source ID is enabled in any module.

methods.name: cleanMetaDataFile
methods.description: Update and clean module metadata files, especially for panels, when sources are removed.

methods.name: updateMetaDataFiles
methods.description: Update module metadata files based on display configuration, adding hover fields where needed.

methods.name: removeHoverField
methods.description: Remove or reset the hover field definitions in a module’s view definitions.

methods.name: setHoverField
methods.description: Add or update a hover field in module view definitions with connector references.

methods.name: setDefaultHoverField
methods.description: Assign the default hover field on a module’s detail view.

methods.name: getConnectorButtonScript
methods.description: Generate HTML code for connector action buttons in the interface.

methods.name: getConnectorStrings
methods.description: Load language strings for a specific connector source.

methods.name: setConnectorStrings
methods.description: Write language strings for a connector source to file.

methods.name: installSource
methods.description: Install a new connector source, updating configuration files accordingly.

methods.name: uninstallSource
methods.description: Remove an existing connector source from configuration files.

methods.name: hasWizardSourceEnabledForModule
methods.description: Check if at least one source for a module is enabled in the wizard configuration.
